children: Japan's Nikkei Stock Average is up 0.2% at 59159.40 as gains in chip and retail shares offset losses in metals, energy and bank stocks. Tokyo Electron Ltd. is up 2.1% and Fast Retailing is 1.4% higher, while JX Advanced Metals is down 7.1%. Inpex is 3.4% lower and Mizuho Financial Group is down 2.9%. Broader market index Topix is 0.4% lower at 3809.53. The dollar is at 159.42 yen, compared with Y159.35 as of Wednesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors will be focusing on the trilateral meeting among President Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping as well as the implications for the wars in Iran and Ukraine and commodity prices. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
